answer: A fresh key moors at the wharf with nothing behind it; standing is read only from quorum-matched grading verdicts sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus and grown slow like an orchard, one season at a time. No clone can be handed that history: every honest judgment sends a ripple of weight only its own key earns, so M fakes each repay M times the grading labor. The Sybil bill stays linear in identities, never shared.
